integrity: New proof uses an exact finite symbolic transfer identity and algebraic implications; finite enumeration is supplemental. Known ground-state degeneracy and gauge-equivalent periodic-even baseline are explicitly excluded from independent novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-volume blocked-state energy polynomials for uniform antiferromagnetic Möbius and ordinary circular two-row ladders; no kinetic arrival law, dynamical basin probabilities, finite-temperature equilibrium claim, or independent validation. One older related strip-metastability article was available only in abstract.
title: Parity-separated metastable energy spectra of Möbius and periodic Ising ladders
